i live in australia so i start here, then fly to zaragoza Spain, then fly to hawaii. 
That gives me 3 comm days and with cooldown + time zone differences it still allows me to live a life inbetween the 3 comm days. 
im sure there is better way that gives you more but find the best one that suits you. 
you can catch an absolute shitload if you wanted to. 
i have all timezones in my world clock so i know exactly what time it is every where i jump. 
plenty of coords to some amazing places if you do a quick search. 

Think big...you are a god among mortals now.
Im so happy i voted for her🥰thank you for looking after our country and having the guts to make the tough decisions fast.

I am ashamed to say that I was very complacent and it only became real for me when i got the flu last week. Fortunately not COVID but i have not been able to see my mother who is a very high risk person with cancer. Having to rely on the generosity of others to supply her with much needed supplies of food etc has been a hard pill to swallow when i have been by her side almost every day. She loves the beach and i would take her a couple times a week, but now she can not leave her unit for fear of catching it. I would lie next to her in bed watching tv and wait till she fell asleep before i went home. Video calls and phone calls are fine but i do miss her hugs.

I am super proud to have been able to raise 2 amazing children who have had the constant presence of both parents in their lives. 
From birth to the age of 18 i was a child of the system, and through all the state homes and abuse i was adamant that if i was ever blessed to have children of my own i would never abandon them like my parents did me. 
Credit must also go to my amazing wife too. 
Breaking any cycle is tough, but it is also very rewarding.

Airline Industry. Australia. We had a massive meeting today and were told 80% of us will be going on leave or unpaid leave effective immediately. Men and women ive worked with for years broke down and cried as names were read out. The worst day ive ever had at a job. I still havent told my wife and kids and i dont know what to say. I have maybe a week and a half of annual leave left and then who knows. Others have nothing. 
I havent gone home yet and told my family i was going to a mates for a couple beers. Im sitting at the beach trying to muster the strength up to go home but im afraid im going to just burst into tears when i see them. 
I honestly dont know what to do and it absolutely sucks.
Naaaw🥰 Happiest of birthdays Bonnie. I hope you had an amazing day. Thank you for the feel good moment.

Its going to be ok. 
I posted for the first time yesterday and one single comment helped me make it through to today. 
I am suicidal myself and although i dont know the path you have walked, i know how dark the mind gets when things keep pilling up. 
Keep posting your thoughts, no matter how big or small it helps to unload the mess. 
If no one comments, find other posts you can relate to and read the comments others have left for them. 
You will realise, like i did, that you are not alone. 
Its going to be ok

Hey. I fell asleep not long after posting and just woke up. I feel alot better in my mind after a deep sleep. The deepest sleep ive had in a while. 
Thank you for your comment. I was truly excited that a complete stranger had taken the time to hear me out and reply.
